headline: Workers around the world take time off to play GTA VI
summary: Outlets report that many people are taking sick days, vacation days, or gaming at the office to mark the long-awaited release of Grand Theft Auto VI.

claims.statement: Many employees are taking time off, or gaming at work, to mark GTA VI's release.

sources.quote: is the whole world really taking the day off work to play GTA VI?
many are going all out to embrace the franchise’s long-awaited release.
